newsitem.title: USA: Continental Health to post Q4 gain.
newsitem.headline: Continental Health to post Q4 gain.

text.p: Continental Health Affiliates Inc said Monday it will post a fourth quarter gain for the period ended June 30, 1997, from the $6.3 million sale of its King David Center in West Palm Beach, Florida.
Chief financial officer S.C. Neill said the company is still computing the amount of the gain. On a cash basis, Continental will net about $1.2 million.
On June 27, Continental had sold a long-term care facility in Atlantic City for $2.5 million as it divests certain underperforming facilities.
